inviteBody: Somi can show you the main screens. You can leave at any time and open it later from Account.
continueBody: You left the guide unfinished. Continue from where you stopped, or open it later from Account.
restartHint: Opens the nine-step guide. It does not edit your profile or substances.

home.title: Welcome to Soma!
home.body: Hi! I'm Somi, and I'll be with you on this adventure. Here you can learn how the body works, follow your progress, and find motivation to keep going.

nav.title: Let's explore!
nav.body: From here you can move between Soma's sections. Each one is a different way to learn, discover, and keep moving forward.

recovery.title: See how things can change
recovery.body: Explore how different processes in the body can change over time. Educational estimates help you understand typical changes linked to leaving substances behind.

explore.title: Knowledge is within reach
explore.body: Find information on substances, body systems, and biological processes. The more you understand what happens in the body, the better equipped you are to make sense of recovery.

anatomy.title: Explore the body!
anatomy.body: Discover organs and systems, learn how they work, and see how different substances can interact with them.

missions.title: Take the challenge!
missions.body: Test what you know with educational activities and challenges. Each mission is a chance to learn something new and keep going.

journal.title: Your story matters too
journal.body: This is your space to write how you feel, note experiences, and reflect on your path. Looking back can show how far you have already come.

achievements.title: Every step counts!
achievements.body: Unlock medals as you explore, learn, and reach new milestones. Small steps deserve to be noticed too.

account.title: Your adventure starts here!
account.body: You now know Soma. Explore at your own pace. If you ever want the tour again, you can replay it from Account.
